limits: T0 precedes a future window, not necessarily physical movement start or physical entry.
No sampled position change is not continuous stillness, deliberate waiting, absence of entry or tactical correctness.
Capture playing does not establish freeze completion or competitive eligibility.
Multiple allies, opposite pair directions and overlapping windows are correlated; counts are not independent tactical decisions.
New C0 T0s have no automatic join to old physical/objective/visual contexts.
Physical entry, tactical commitment, legal contact, physical NAV, instantaneous velocity, carried/dropped C4, full timing/readiness, cooperation and intent retain their positive-source dependencies.
No DecisionExample/catalog/DEC-TRADE-001 expansion, recommendation, training, release/promotion or corpus-wide migration.
